senses.gloss: वि-भाषा वि-भाषा, indecl. alternatively, either of two ways, optionally.
विभा- + वसु विभा- + वसु, m. 1. the sun, Lass. 2. ed. 78, 76. 2. the moon, Śṛṅgārat. 2. 3. fire.

विभक्ति विभक्ति, i. e. वि-भज् + ति, f.
 1. A partition, division, Man. 1, 24. []
 2. Part.
 3. Inheritance.
 4. An affix of declension, Pāṇ. i. 4, 104; v. 3, 1, sqq.

विभङ्ग विभङ्ग, i. e. वि-भञ्ज् + अ, m.
 1. Breaking.
 2. Fracture.
 3. Stopping, Bhartṛ. 2, 60.
 4. Bending, contracting (especially of the eyebrows).
 5. Expression of features.
 6. Division.
 --Comp.

विभव विभव, i. e. वि-भू + अ, m.
 1. Power, Bhartṛ. 2, 49.
 2. Supreme or superhuman power, Kir. 5, 21.
 3. Wealth, Pañc. iii. d. 96.
 4. Property.
 5. Substance.
 6. Thing, Pañc. iii. d. 167.
 7. Magnanimity.
 8. Emancipation from existence.
 --Comp.

विभाव विभाव, i. e. वि-भू + अ, m.
 1. An acquaintance.
 2. An excitant of the sentiments of poetical composition, Sāh. Darp. p. 31.
 3. The affections or sentiments, as love, Sch. ad Nalod. 2, 8.
विभवतस् विभव + तस्, adj. Agreeably to one's power or rank, to the royal majesty, Mālav. 19, 1; Vikr. 30, 18.

विभा वि-भा, f.
 1. Light.
 2. Lustre, Nalod. 1, 48.
 3. Beauty.
 4. A ray of light.

विभाकर विभा-कर, m.
 1. The sun, Sāh. Darp. p. 312, 2.
 2. Fire.

विभाग विभाग, i. e. वि-भज् + अ, m.
 1. Dividing, Bhāṣāp. 3; division, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 23; Hit. 119, 18; arrangement, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 15.
 2. Part, Pañc. 243, 20; 241, 7.
 3. Distribution, Rājat. 5, 111.
 4. Partition of inheritance, Man. 1, 115.
 5. The share or portion of inheritance.
 --Comp.
विभागतस् विभाग + तस्, adv. Proportionately.
विभागशस् विभाग + शस्, adv. Proportionately, part for part, Man. 12, 17; Bhag. 4, 13.
विभावक विभावक, i. e. वि-भू, Caus., + अक, adj. Discussing, illustrating.

I. विभा + वन्, adj., f. वरी, Shining, 287, 1 = Rigv. i. 48, 1; Chr. 295, 14 = Rigv. i. 92, 14.
 II. वि-भा + वन्, f. वरी.
 1. Night, Rām. 2, 84, 18.
 2. A harlot.
 3. A bawd.
 4. Turmeric.

विभावन विभावन, i. e. वि-भू + अन, n.
 1. Discussion.
 2. Ascertaining, Vikr. 78, 10 (reading).
 3. Perceiving distinctly, Man. 2, 101.
 4. Conceiving, imagination.
विभावरी विभावरी, see विभावन्.
विभाविन् विभाविन्, i. e. विभाव + इन्, adj., f. नी, Exciting love, Nalod. 2, 8.
विभीतक वि-भीत + क (vb. भी), m., f. (की), A plant, Terminalia belerica, Lass. 52, 15 (m.).

विभीषण विभीषण, i. e. वि-भी, Caus., + अन,
 I. adj. Terrific, horrible, Hiḍ. 2, 4.
 II. m. The brother of Rāvaṇa.
 III. f. णा, and n. The property of exciting fear, terrifying, a means of terrifying, Draup. 5, 10 (n.).
 --Comp.
विभीषिका विभीषिका, i. e. वि-भी, Caus., + अक, f. A means of terrifying, Utt. Rāmac. 117, 1; Pañc. 160, 17.

विभु विभु, i. e. वि-भू,
 I. adj.
 1. Omnipresent.
 2. All-pervading, pervading, Bhāṣāp. 50; 93.
 3. Eternal.
 4. Firm, solid.
 II. m.
 1. A master, a lord, Pañc. 202, 10; Chr. 33, 2; [] used particularly in addressing, Indr. 1, 39; Chr. 13, 15; 17, 27.
 2. One who is able (with infin.), Kir. 5, 43.
 3. Śiva.
 4. Brahman.
 5. Viṣṇu.
 6. The soul.
 7. Time.
 8. Space.
 9. Æther.
 10. A servant.
विभुता विभु + ता, f., and विभुत्व विभु + त्व, n. Power, Śāk. d. 42 (त्व).

विभूति वि-भू + ति, f.
 1. Power, dignity, Pañc. 203, 1.
 2. Superhuman power, Hit. iii. d. 115.
 3. Ashes of cow-dung.

विभूतिमन्त् विभूति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती,
 1. Powerful.
 2. Superhuman, Bhag. 10, 41.
विभूषण विभूषण, i. e. वि-भूष् + अन, n. Ornament, decoration, Pañc. ii. d. 168.

विभूषा वि-भूष् + आ, f.
 1. Light, lustre.
 2. Ornament.
विभेत्तृ विभेत्तृ, i. e. वि-भिद् + तृ, m. A destroyer, Śāk. d. 163.

विभेद विभेद, i. e. वि-भिद् + अ, m.
 1. Dividing, Kir. 13, 1.
 2. Breaking, violating, Hit. iv. d. 124.
 3. Wounding.
 4. Bewildering.
 5. A separation.
 6. Distinction.
 7. Contradiction.
 8. Enmity.
विभ्रंश वि-भ्रंश् + अ, m. A precipice, Bhāg. P. 8, 22, 5.
विभ्रंशिन् वि-भ्रंश् + इन्, adj. Falling, fallen, Megh. 68.

विभ्रम वि-भ्रम् + अ, m.
 1. Whirling, Hit. iii. d. 140; going round, Kathās. 20, 226 (agitation); motion, Mālat. 15, 12.
 2. Error, Utt. Rāmac. 23, 3 (हार-, adj. Producing the error of a necklace, i. e. like a necklace); Rājat. 5, 332 (बभ्रुः--सटा-पाटल-विभ्रमम्, Could be mistaken for [i. e. were like] [] a Bignonia-like mane).
 3. Erroneous use, Man. 7, 24.
 4. Doubt.
 5. Play (of the eyes), Śāk. d. 23.
 6. Amorous actions, Pañc. i. d. 151; flurry, confusion, perturbation, Bhag. 2, 63.
 7. Enrapture, Mālat. 155, 7.
 8. Beauty, Pañc. v. d. 3; grace, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 6.
 --Comp.

विभ्राज् वि-भ्राज्, adj.
 1. Shining.
 2. Elegant, richly dressed.

विभ्रान्ति विभ्रान्ति, i. e. वि-भ्रम् + ति, f.
 1. Whirling, going round.
 2. Hurry, precipitation.
 3. Error.
 4. Confusion.
विभीषिका- + स्थान विभीषिका- + स्थान, n. object, or means, of frightening, Pañc. 160, 21.
